_doc: Collected starter data for the four EXTENDED key characteristics (KCC 11-14).
Companion to db/seed/refs/foundational.json and db/seed/kccs.json.
SCOPE OF THIS FILE
The 14 KCC framework definitions (incl. 11-14) already exist in db/seed/kccs.json.
What was MISSING is the *evidence layer* for 11-14: every populated table
(evidence, assay_kccs, iarc_monograph_kc_calls, iarc_monograph_kc_strength)
covers only kcc-01..kcc-10, because both upstream sources only map the original 10:
- KCAD  (Rigutto et al. 2025)  -> assays mapped to KC1-KC10
- IARC 10-yr (Rusyn et al. 2024) -> calls/strength for KC1-KC10
This file supplies the first defensible layer for 11-14: anchor REFERENCES
(literature -> KCC links) and CANDIDATE ASSAYS (method -> KCC links).
WHAT THIS FILE DELIBERATELY DOES NOT CONTAIN
Agent x KCC evidence SCORES are NOT provided. The scoring rule in
docs/KCC_EVIDENCE_RULES.md is deterministic over peer-reviewed source tables;
no such table yet scores agents against KCC 11-14. Fabricating scores would
inject unsourced data into a CC-BY scientific resource. Scores must come from
curator action (Revision workflow) or a future peer-reviewed source importer.
PROVENANCE / VERIFICATION
Bibliographic identifiers below were verified against publisher/PubMed records.
Entries carry needs_curator_review=true so a human signs off before a tagged
release. The 14-KCC framework itself is an EXTENSION proposal: IARC's endorsed
canon is the original 10 (Smith et al. 2016). KCC 11-14 draw on the cancer-
hallmarks 'new dimensions' literature (Hanahan 2022) and the non-genotoxic /
stem-cell / GJIC carcinogenesis tradition. Keep is_extended=true on these KCCs.

references.title: Hallmarks of Cancer: New Dimensions
references._note: Adds polymorphic microbiomes + senescent cells as enabling characteristics and phenotypic plasticity/disrupted differentiation as a hallmark; primary crosswalk anchor for KCC 11/12/13.

references.authors: Senga SS, Bisson WH, Colacci A
references.title: Key characteristics of carcinogens meet hallmarks for prevention - cutting the Gordian knot
references._note: Argues current KCCs capture early events but not full malignancy; motivates extension toward processes covered by KCC 11-14.

references.authors: Sepich-Poore GD, Zitvogel L, Straussman R, Hasty J, Wargo JA, Knight R
references.title: The microbiome and human cancer
references._note: Distinguishes causal vs complicit microbial roles via the immuno-oncology-microbiome axis. NB: 2024 erratum (Science 385:eadt2260) removed reliance on a since-retracted reference; verify quoted claims.

references.authors: Faget DV, Ren Q, Stewart SA
references.title: Unmasking senescence: context-dependent effects of SASP in cancer
references._note: Establishes the dual (suppressive vs pro-tumorigenic) role of senescence/SASP depending on cell of origin and disease stage.

references.title: On the potential origin and characteristics of cancer stem cells
references._note: DOI/PMID to be confirmed by curator before tagged release (vol/pages verified; DOI not asserted).

references.authors: Trosko JE, Chang CC, Madhukar BV, Klaunig JE
references.title: Chemical, oncogene and growth factor inhibition of gap junctional intercellular communication: an integrative hypothesis of carcinogenesis
references._note: Foundational GJIC-inhibition hypothesis of tumour promotion. Journal/vol to be curator-confirmed (PMID verified).

references.authors: Mesnil M, Krutovskikh V, Omori Y, Yamasaki H
references.title: Role of blocked gap junctional intercellular communication in non-genotoxic carcinogenesis
references._note: Connexin genes as a tumour-suppressor family; GJIC loss as a non-genotoxic mechanism.

candidate_assays.name: 16S rRNA / shotgun metagenomic community profiling
candidate_assays.notes: Detects exposure-driven dysbiosis (diversity shifts, taxa abundance).

candidate_assays.name: Colibactin / genotoxin adduct & pks-island detection
candidate_assays.notes: Links KCC-11 to KCC-02 (genotoxicity) via microbial metabolites.

candidate_assays.name: Senescence-associated beta-galactosidase (SA-beta-gal) assay
candidate_assays.notes: Canonical senescence marker; pair with p16/p21 and SASP panel.

candidate_assays.name: SASP cytokine secretome panel (e.g., IL-6, IL-8, MMPs)
Sphere-formation / self-renewal assay
candidate_assays.notes: Tumour-/mammo-/colono-sphere formation as a self-renewal readout.

candidate_assays.name: ALDH activity / stem-marker flow cytometry
candidate_assays.notes: ALDH(hi)/CD44/CD133 enrichment as candidate stem-dynamics readouts.

candidate_assays.name: Scrape-loading / dye-transfer (GJIC) assay
candidate_assays.notes: Classic dye-coupling readout for non-genotoxic tumour-promoter screening.

candidate_assays.name: Connexin expression / membrane localization
candidate_assays.notes: Aberrant connexin localization accompanies GJIC loss in promotion.
